criteria.requirement: Implement dpath.transforming.transform_existing(root,transform,*,predicate=None), using completed walk_paths and get_exact rather than glob strings. Evaluate only original snapshot leaves (including empty containers), pass typed tuple path and detached value to callbacks, write replacements into a deep-copied result and never revisit newly generated content. Predicate is optional; late callback or cycle errors propagate while original objects remain unchanged, including callback mutations of supplied values. Root-leaf replacement works; preserve shared-copy alias semantics and source traversal order.
